title: Quick Roasted British Barramundi Cottage Pie
description: A hearty, comforting British dish featuring roasted barramundi, sweet potato, and a crispy mashed potato crust.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are baking, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the barramundi fillets, cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Toss the mashed potato topping with chilli flakes, lemon juice, and salt, pepper to taste.
Transfer the roasted barramundi to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spoon the mashed potato topping over the barramundi.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
